name: load-balancer-3-server
description: Load balancer Traefik + 5 backend server di Docker, tiap server punya URL sendiri, lengkap dengan CRUD katalog server di MariaDB, test suite, k6 di container, dan dashboard Grafana.

scripts.db:reset: docker compose -p lb-db -f docker-compose.db.yml down -v && docker compose -p lb-db -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d
scripts.k6:up: docker compose -p lb-k6 -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up -d --build influxdb grafana prometheus k6-runner
scripts.k6:run: docker compose -p lb-k6 -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml run --rm k6
scripts.k6:watch: docker compose -p lb-k6 -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml run --rm --service-ports -e K6_WEB_DASHBOARD=true k6
scripts.stack:up: npm run net:up && npm run db:up && npm run traefik:up && npm run docker:up && npm run k6:up
scripts.stack:down: npm run k6:down && npm run docker:down && npm run traefik:down && npm run db:down
